comment: E6 — redacted-Move cross-server projection. Spec authority: MAL-14 (redact reducer) + crypto-media/redaction.md. A redaction Move on peer A propagates to peer B's projection. Per MAL-14, the cell-level model preserves the original message and writes a parallel redaction_cells entry; the projected view depends on viewer-is-author (full audit view) vs member (tombstone-only). Cross-server: peer B must produce the same per-viewer projection peer A produces.

encoder.redaction_cell_model: redaction_cells: BTreeMap<message_id, Option<RedactionCellValue>>; original MessageState preserved

viewer_views.author: full message body + redaction metadata (audit view)
viewer_views.privileged_member_override: tombstone only — admin authority does NOT bypass redaction privacy

vectors.name: redaction_propagates_to_peer_b_member_sees_tombstone
vectors.comment: Author@peer_a sends message m1; admin@peer_a issues redaction Move on m1. Peer B pulls and projects. A non-author member viewer on peer B sees only the tombstone — body is hidden, redacted_by/redacted_at metadata visible.

expected.rationale: Non-author members see only the redaction tombstone post-redaction; body is hidden cross-server.

vectors.name: redaction_propagates_author_audit_view_full_body
vectors.comment: Same redaction Move; on peer B, the author@peer_a's own session views m1. Per MAL-14 author-audit-view rule, the author sees the full body + redaction metadata (audit trail).

expected.rationale: Author audit view: original body + redaction metadata both visible. Cross-server consistent with peer A.

vectors.name: un_redaction_move_propagates_cross_server_restores_body
vectors.comment: Admin issues an un-redact Move on m1 (writes RedactionCell::None). Peer B pulls and projects. Member viewer now sees the full body again — un-redaction is causal-only and propagates cross-server.

expected.rationale: Un-redaction restores the body for non-author members; propagates cross-server idempotently.
